summary: Completed e2e testing of Campus Mobility platform. 18/18 backend pytest tests pass (auth, register, drivers, full ride workflow including atomic accept 409, role enforcement, analytics, websocket valid+invalid token). Frontend critical UI flows verified: landing, login via demo buttons (passenger & driver), passenger ride request -> active ride card visible -> cancel, driver dashboard with online toggle, logout returns to login.

integration_issues.issue: pickup-select / destination-select shadcn dropdowns: clicking the trigger and then waiting did not surface [role=option] elements via the standard query (0 options found). The ride was still created (likely because the form already had default values pre-selected). Verify that options are rendered inside a Radix portal and consider adding data-testid on each SelectItem for easier automation.

Driver1 dashboard shows RATING 5.0 / 0 reviews and TOTAL RIDES 0 / 'No rides yet' even though seed sets rating_avg=4.8 rating_count=24 and seeds 18 historical rides randomly assigned to d1/d2. Seed only sets these values on initial insert (if existing user is present, seed is skipped) so an older user document with defaults may persist. Consider making seed idempotently update rating/vehicle/online fields when the user already exists.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid attributes to SelectItem options inside pickup/destination dropdowns to make UI automation more robust.

Optional: make seed_data update existing user docs (rating_avg, rating_count, vehicle, is_online, lat/lng) instead of skipping when email already exists, so demo data stays consistent across redeploys.
Optional: surface a clear visual disabled/loading state on the request-ride button while POST /api/rides/request is in flight.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~620 lines and combines auth, models, ride logic, analytics, websocket and seed. Consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/rides.py, routers/drivers.py, services/seed.py for maintainability.

CORS is set to '*' while allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Cookies will not be sent cross-origin from the frontend. Currently the frontend uses Bearer tokens from localStorage so it works, but the httpOnly cookie path is effectively unused/broken. Either restrict CORS_ORIGINS to the frontend URL or stop setting the cookie.
JWT_SECRET is committed in backend/.env. Should be rotated for production deployment.
websocket /api/ws closes with code 4401 on bad token but does not call websocket.accept() first; some clients will see this as a generic connection-failed. Acceptable.

rate_ride increments driver rating_count/rating_avg directly on user document, but if multiple completions race, the read-modify-write could lose updates. Use $inc and an aggregated avg calculation or a transaction.
demand_analytics scans up to 2000 rides per call and aggregates in Python. Move to a Mongo aggregation pipeline ($hour / $group) once volume grows.
test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md as-is: admin@iitr.ac.in/admin123, passenger@iitr.ac.in/passenger123, driver1@iitr.ac.in/driver123, driver2@iitr.ac.in/driver123, driver3@iitr.ac.in/driver123
seed_data_creation: No new seed data needed. Backend test created two TEST_-prefixed users (TEST_passenger_<hex>@iitr.ac.in, TEST_driver_<hex>@iitr.ac.in) during register flow and a few ride records (one full completed+rated workflow + a couple of cancelled rides) using the existing seed passenger/drivers. Not cleaned up but prefixed for easy identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py uses BASE_URL = REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and covers health/auth/drivers/rides/analytics/websocket. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v. WebSocket tests require the `websockets` pip package (installed). All 18 pass. Frontend automation should be aware that pickup/destination select options are rendered in a Radix portal so [role=option] selectors might need a small additional wait or be located via page.locator('div[data-radix-popper-content-wrapper] [role=option]').
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Two minor data/UX observations: (1) Seed idempotency: existing users are not updated on re-seed, so historical demo state (rating, vehicle) may drift to defaults if a user was created earlier without those fields. (2) Radix Select portals are not directly addressable via [role=option] without giving the portal a moment to mount — recommend adding data-testid per SelectItem.
